title: Identifying an Optimal Neuroinflammation Treatment Using a Nanoligomer Discovery Engine.
authors: Sharma, Sadhana; Borski, Curtis; Hanson, Jessica; Garcia, Micklaus A; Link, Christopher D; Hoeffer, Charles; Chatterjee, Anushree; Nagpal, Prashant
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AI排名方法设计Nanoligomer肽分子靶向NF-kappaB和TNFR1以抑制神经炎症，虽涉及转录因子NF-kappaB但核心是基因表达调控和药物筛选，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute activation of innate immune response in the brain, or neuroinflammation, protects this vital organ from a range of external pathogens and promotes healing after traumatic brain injury. However, chronic neuroinflammation leading to the activation of immune cells like microglia and astrocytes causes damage to the nervous tissue, and it is causally linked to a range of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's diseases (AD), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), Parkinson's disease (PD), and many others. While neuroinflammation is a key target for a range of neuropathological diseases, there is a lack of effective countermeasures to tackle it, and existing experimental therapies require fairly invasive intracerebral and intrathecal delivery due to difficulty associated with the therapeutic crossover between the blood-brain barrier, making such treatments impractical to treat neuroinflammation long-term. Here, we present the development of an optimal neurotherapeutic using our Nanoligomer Discovery Engine, by screening downregulation of several proinflammatory cytokines (e.g., Interleukin-1beta or IL-1beta, tumor necrosis factor-alpha or TNF-alpha, TNF receptor 1 or TNFR1, Interleukin 6 or IL-6), inflammasomes (e.g., NLRP1), key transcription factors (e.g., nuclear factor kappa-B or NF-kappabeta) and their combinations, as upstream regulators and canonical pathway targets, to identify and validate the best-in-class treatment. Using our high-throughput drug discovery, target validation, and lead molecule identification via a bioinformatics and artificial intelligence-based ranking method to design sequence-specific peptide molecules to up- or downregulate gene expression of the targeted gene at will, we used our discovery engine to perturb and identify most effective upstream regulators and canonical pathways for therapeutic intervention to reverse neuroinflammation. The lead neurotherapeutic was a combination of Nanoligomers targeted to NF-kappabeta (SB.201.17D.8_NF-kappabeta1) and TNFR1 (SB.201.18D.6_TNFR1), which were identified using in vitro cell-based screening in donor-derived human astrocytes and further validated in vivo using a mouse model of lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced neuroinflammation. The combination treatment SB_NI_111 was delivered without any special formulation using a simple intraperitoneal injection of low dose (5 mg/kg) and was found to significantly suppress the expression of LPS-induced neuroinflammation in mouse hippocampus. These results point to the broader applicability of this approach towards the development of therapies for chronic neuroinflammation-linked neurodegenerative diseases, sleep countermeasures, and others, and the potential for further investigation of the lead neurotherapeutic molecule as reversible gene therapy.
abstract_zh: 大脑中先天免疫反应的急性激活，即神经炎症（neuroinflammation），保护这一重要器官免受多种外部病原体的侵害，并促进创伤性脑损伤后的愈合。然而，慢性神经炎症导致小胶质细胞（microglia）和星形胶质细胞（astrocytes）等免疫细胞的激活，会对神经组织造成损伤，并与一系列神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）、多发性硬化（Multiple Sclerosis, MS）、帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）等）存在因果关联。尽管神经炎症是多种神经病理学疾病的关键靶点，但目前缺乏有效的应对措施，且现有实验性疗法因血脑屏障（blood-brain barrier）之间的治疗性穿越困难，需要相当侵入性的脑内和鞘内给药，使得此类治疗在长期应对神经炎症方面不切实际。在此，我们利用我们的Nanoligomer发现引擎（Nanoligomer Discovery Engine）开发了一种优化的神经治疗药物，通过筛选多种促炎细胞因子（如白细胞介素-1β（Interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）、TNF受体1（TNF receptor 1, TNFR1）、白细胞介素6（Interleukin 6, IL-6））、炎症小体（如NLRP1）、关键转录因子（如核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa-B, NF-kappabeta））及其组合的下调，作为上游调控因子和经典通路靶点，以识别并验证最佳治疗方案。通过我们的高通量药物发现、靶点验证和先导分子鉴定，采用基于生物信息学和人工智能的排序方法设计序列特异性肽分子，以随意上调或下调靶基因的基因表达，我们利用发现引擎扰动并识别最有效的上游调控因子和经典通路，用于治疗干预以逆转神经炎症。先导神经治疗药物是针对NF-kappabeta（SB.201.17D.8_NF-kappabeta1）和TNFR1（SB.201.18D.6_TNFR1）的Nanoligomer组合，通过供体来源的人星形胶质细胞中的体外细胞筛选识别，并进一步在脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的神经炎症小鼠模型中进行了体内验证。该组合治疗SB_NI_111无需特殊配方，通过简单的低剂量（5 mg/kg）腹腔注射给药，被发现能显著抑制小鼠海马中LPS诱导的神经炎症表达。这些结果表明，该方法在开发针对慢性神经炎症相关神经退行性疾病、睡眠对策及其他疾病的疗法方面具有更广泛的适用性，并为进一步研究先导神经治疗分子作为可逆基因疗法提供了潜力。
